```{python}

stats = (
    result
    .select(
        "*",
        F.size("sentences").alias("num_sentences"),
        F.size("normalized").alias("num_words")
    )
    .groupBy("title", "type", "author")
    .agg(
      F.sum("num_sentences").alias("num_sentences"),
      F.sum("num_words").alias("num_words")
    )
)

import re

vowels = "aeiouyàâäéèêëîïôöùûüÿœæ"

@F.udf("int")
def count_syllables(word):
    groups = re.findall(rf'[{vowels}]+', word)
    return max(len(groups), 1)

normalized = (
  result
  .select(
      "*",
      F.explode("normalized.result").alias("word")
  )
)

syllables = (
    normalized
    .withColumn(
        "syllables",
        count_syllables("word")
    )
    .groupBy("title", "type", "author")
    .agg(
        F.sum("syllables").alias("num_syllables")
    )
)

final = (
    stats
    .join(syllables, on=["title", "type", "author"])
)

final = (
    final
    .withColumn(
        "kandel_moles",
        (
            207
            - 1.015 * (
                F.col("num_words")
                / F.col("num_sentences")
            )
            - 73.6 * (
                F.col("num_syllables")
                / F.col("num_words")
            )
        )
    )
    .withColumn(
        "flesch_kincaid",
        (
            206.835
            - 1.015 * (
                F.col("num_words")
                / F.col("num_sentences")
            )
            - 84.6 * (
                F.col("num_syllables")
                / F.col("num_words")
            )
        )
    )
)

```

```{python}

import plotly.express as px

final_pd = final.sort("kandel_moles", ascending=True).toPandas()

fig = px.bar(
    final_pd,
    x="title",
    y="kandel_moles",
    title="Indice de Kandel-Moles par Livre",
    labels={"title": "Livre", "kandel_moles": "Indice Kandel-Moles"},
    color="type",
    category_orders={"title": final_pd["title"].tolist()}
)
fig.show()

```

```{python}

kandel_author_pd = (
    final
    .groupBy("author")
    .agg(F.avg("kandel_moles").alias("kandel_moles_moyen"))
    .sort("kandel_moles_moyen", ascending=True)
    .toPandas()
)

fig_author = px.bar(
    kandel_author_pd,
    x="author",
    y="kandel_moles_moyen",
    title="Indice de Kandel-Moles moyen par auteur",
    labels={"author": "Auteur", "kandel_moles_moyen": "Indice Kandel-Moles moyen"},
    category_orders={"author": kandel_author_pd["author"].tolist()}
)
fig_author.show()

```

```{python}

from pyspark.sql import Window

zipf = (
    result
    .select(
        "title",
        F.explode("normalized.result").alias("word")
    )
    .where(
        F.col("word").isNotNull()
        & (F.length(F.trim(F.col("word"))) > 0)
    )
    .withColumn("word", F.lower(F.col("word")))
    .groupBy("title", "word")
    .agg(F.count("*").alias("freq"))
)

rank_window = Window.partitionBy("title").orderBy(F.desc("freq"), F.asc("word"))

zipf_ranked_pd = (
    zipf
    .withColumn("rank", F.row_number().over(rank_window))
    .select("title", "rank", "freq")
    .toPandas()
)

for title, book_df in zipf_ranked_pd.groupby("title", sort=False):
    fig_zipf = px.scatter(
        book_df.sort_values("rank"),
        x="rank",
        y="freq",
        log_x=True,
        log_y=True,
        title=f"Zipf plot - {title}",
        labels={"rank": "Rang", "freq": "Fréquence"}
    )
    fig_zipf.update_traces(mode="lines+markers", marker={"size": 4})
    fig_zipf.show()

```
